protocol: nested patient label subsets; audit labels included; fixed seed; no VAL selection
required_external_baselines: HCO exact algorithm after full-text review; sign control is NOT HCO
additional_ablation: head versus decoder scope; same initialization and pseudo grouping
compute_controls: supervised_extra is label-use control, not an exact wall-time match; report runtime/JVP/trial overhead and learning curves

batch_protocol.selection: image-only random spatial crop; coordinate-aligned labels; edge padding excluded from CE/Dice/audit/pseudo denominator
batch_protocol.factor: new fixed crop/batch experiment; do not pool native B16 outcomes

execution_queue: finish already-running EMA-block, score final checkpoint, push results, then stop
